LESSON: BELIEF IN ALLAH

Grade: PP1
Subject: ISLAMIC RELIGIOUS EDUCATION
Strand: PILLARS
Topic 2.1: Belief in Allah

SECTION 1: WELCOME

Hello! Today we learn about Belief in Allah. Read the explanation, study the examples, do the practice, then try the revision quiz.

Big question: How am I similar/ a) identify oneself as a creation looking at themselves in the different from others?

SECTION 2: WHAT YOU WILL LEARN

By the end of this lesson, you will be able to:

1. Explain the main ideas in Belief in Allah
2. Practise Belief in Allah at school and at home
3. Give Kenyan examples connected to Belief in Allah

SECTION 3: LEARN STEP BY STEP

1. Explain the main ideas in Belief in Allah
   In simple words: practise until you can explain the main ideas in Belief in Allah. Use examples from school and home in Kenya.

2. Practise Belief in Allah at school and at home
   In simple words: practise until you can practise Belief in Allah at school and at home. Use examples from school and home in Kenya.

3. Give Kenyan examples connected to Belief in Allah
   In simple words: practise until you can give Kenyan examples connected to Belief in Allah. Use examples from school and home in Kenya.

SECTION 4: EXAMPLES

Example 1: Talk about Belief in Allah using something you see at school in Kenya.

Example 2: Give a home example from your county, estate, or village.

Example 3: Teach a younger child one idea from this lesson in simple words.

SECTION 5: TRY THIS

1. Underline two new ideas about Belief in Allah in the examples.
2. Explain Belief in Allah to a parent using one local example.
3. Draw or write three things that show you understand Belief in Allah.
4. Practise one skill from this lesson with a friend.

SECTION 6: WORK TO DO (PRACTICE & REVISION)

1. Write five sentences about Belief in Allah using examples from school or home.
2. Answer: Why is Belief in Allah important for a PP1 learner?
3. Make a one-minute oral presentation to a parent or teacher.
4. List three ways you will practise this topic this week.

SECTION 7: CLASS ACTIVITY IDEAS

1. Engage learners in group discussion about themselves
2. Sing songs / Anashid /qasida and recite poems related to the strand
3. Learners are exposed to games/hands-on activities related to the strand
4. Learners are engaged in discussion on good and bad touches

SECTION: REMEMBER

1. Explain the main ideas in Belief in Allah
2. Practise Belief in Allah at school and at home
3. Give Kenyan examples connected to Belief in Allah

Now complete the Revision Quiz. Open the Answers tab only after you finish.

— CBC Learn · Original learner lesson from KICD outcomes (Strategy 2)
